meta.project: FPT University Ho Chi Minh City — Academic Building Digital Twin V4
meta.location: Saigon Hi-Tech Park, Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
meta.units: METRIC (1 Blender Unit = 1 Three.js Unit = 1.0 meter)
meta.disclaimer: Only published site area, design GFA, and written peak floor references are classified VERIFIED. All envelope, wing depth, bay rhythm, and landscape dimensions are MEASURED_FROM_REFERENCE or ESTIMATED approximations — not survey-grade CAD/BIM drawings.

site_area_design.source: VTN Architects / ArchDaily published project brief

gross_floor_area_design.source: VTN Architects / FPT University published project data (29,000–29,926 m2)

site_width.source: Derived non-square rectangular parcel matching 22,500 m2 site envelope
site_width.measurement_method: Proportional parcel aspect ratio from aerial context

building_width.source: VTN aerial & courtyard-to-wing visual proportion analysis
building_width.measurement_method: Proportional estimate within 110–125 m reference envelope

building_length.source: VTN aerial & courtyard-to-wing visual proportion analysis
building_length.measurement_method: Proportional estimate within 105–125 m reference envelope

building_wing_depth.measurement_method: Estimated from facade bay count and 30% site coverage constraint

courtyard_width.source: Building width (116 m) minus 2 x wing depth (19 m)
courtyard_width.measurement_method: Derived from ring envelope and aerial courtyard ratio

courtyard_length.source: Building length (112 m) minus 2 x wing depth (19 m)
courtyard_length.measurement_method: Derived from ring envelope and aerial courtyard ratio

primary_peak_floors.source: VTN Architects & FPT University written project documentation
primary_peak_floors.measurement_method: Published architectural specification + photo count check

structural_bay_width.source: Facade window-pier rhythm from completed-campus photographs
structural_bay_width.measurement_method: Bay count division along wing length

window_width.source: Recessed classroom window proportion relative to 4.0 m structural bay

window_height.source: Recessed classroom window proportion relative to 3.6 m floor height

parapet_and_railing_height.source: Vietnam building safety code parapet/railing standard

planter_height.source: Integrated concrete facade & terrace planter boxes
planter_height.measurement_method: Visual proportion relative to 1.1 m parapet

terrace_setback.measurement_method: Derived from mountain silhouette slope across 6/9/11 floors
